name: Claude
description: Claude's home, usage and model picker.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review the changes on this branch
commands.insert: Review the changes on this branch against its base: correctness first, then tests, then naming. List each finding with its file and line.

commands.name: pr
commands.description: Commit, push and open a pull request
commands.insert: Commit the current changes with a clear message, push the branch and open a pull request that says what changed and how it was tested.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run the tests and fix what fails
commands.insert: Run this project's tests. For each failure, find the cause and fix it, then run them again until they pass.

commands.name: explain
commands.insert: Explain how this works, where it is called from and what would break if it changed:

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list your recent Claude chats.
scopes.usage_app:read: Read the usage left on your Claude accounts from cmux's Usage app.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Start a Claude chat from the prompt box, or open a chat in a tab.
